dct_description_sm: Mineral Resources Division, Tanzania ; v/o Technoexpoet, Moscow, Geology and Mines Division, Tanzania ; German Geological Mission, Tanzania ; Geological Survey of Tanganyika.
Relief shown by contours, hachures, and spot heights.
Some sheets issued in preliminary editions.
Before 1965, published by Geological Survey Department of Tanganyika. Some sheets published for Government of Tanzania by Bundesanstalt für Bondenforschung, Hannover.
"Kilamanjaro-Moshi" sheet is a "special sheet (covering quarter degree sheets 42, 56 and 57)."
Sheet 153, "Mpanda" by V/O Technoexport, Moscow; Sheets 247, "Malangali" and 248, "Mufindi" by the German Geological Mission in Tanzania.

Includes text, "Brief explanation of the geology," "Administrative Divisions" diagram, flight diagram, geologic column, quarter degree sheet index, notes, and ill. of Tanganyika, and later Tanzania, Geological Survey logo.
